How much does a project cost?

It depends on what you need, which is why you get a fixed price in writing within 48 hours of our call. A payment integration is a small project. A website plus iOS and Android app is a bigger one. Either way the price doesn't change unless you change the scope.
Who owns the code and the designs?
You do, 100%. Code, designs, domain, App Store accounts and data are yours. If you ever leave, you take everything with you.
What if I don't like the design?
We revise it until you do. Nothing gets built until you approve the designs in Figma, so there are no surprises when the product arrives.
A landing page can be live in under two weeks and a payment integration in days. A full website plus app usually takes around 12 weeks from our first call, including design, building and testing.
Can you fix an app I built with Lovable or Replit?
Yes. We start with a free audit, then fix security, payments, speed and scaling while keeping what already works. You don't have to start over.
We're an agency. How does white-label work?
We sign an NDA, join your Slack and tools, and deliver under your brand. Your client never hears our name. You get partner pricing and weekly reports you can forward as-is.
Can the website and app be in Arabic?
Yes. Every website and app we build can run in English and Arabic, including right-to-left layouts. It's included from the custom tiers.
Are your prices in AED, and do they include VAT?
Yes, all prices are fixed in AED. They exclude 5% VAT, which appears on the invoice.
